title: Patisallāna
text: 2. Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || Kiñca yathābhūtam pajānāti || || 3. Idaṃ dukkhan ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || ayam dukkhasamudayo ti yathābhūtam || pe || ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yathābhūtam pajānāti || || [page 415] Saṃyutta-Nikāya. 415 4. Paṭisallāṇe bhikkhave yogam āpajjatha || paṭisallīno bhikkhave bhikkhu yathābhūtam pajānāti || || Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave Idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || pe || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇīyo ti || ||
